title: Emrys and the Bell
author: Coral Dunmore
blurb: Vesper Okafor, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
